description: This Java interface defines a collection of Subject objects within a policy framework, including methods for creation, retrieval, modification, removal, and JSON serialization of subjects.

classes.name: Subjects
classes.description: An interface representing a collection of Subject objects, supporting creation, access, modification, removal, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new Subjects instance from an iterable of Subject objects or from a single Subject and additional Subjects.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the JSON schema versions supported by Subjects, specifically version 2.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Retrieves a Subject by its issuer and ID, or by a combined issuer+ID string, returning an Optional.

methods.name: setSubject
methods.description: Sets or replaces a Subject in the collection, returning a new Subjects instance.

methods.name: removeSubject
methods.description: Removes a Subject by issuer+ID string, issuer and subject, or by SubjectId, returning a new Subjects instance.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of Subjects in the collection.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the collection contains no Subjects.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a sequential Stream of Subjects for processing.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Subjects to a JsonObject, including only non-hidden fields.
